title: Keep adopted predecessor reporting retryable during temporary stop and binding recovery
outcome: Temporary stop, reset, binding recovery and unresolved authority do not permanently discard an adopted predecessor's uncertain report; genuine custody changes remain refused.
acceptance: A deterministic adopted-successor regression encounters a temporary stop or binding-recovery state during predecessor capture and later retains the original predecessor report under its original association after that temporary state clears.
Real root, store, connection or exact-job custody changes remain refused without attributing the predecessor to its successor.
